profile.headline: Software Engineer- Field Testing at isee ai
profile.summary:
Master of Science in Electrical Engineer with specialization in Control Systems and Unmanned Vehicles.
•	Experienced professional with expertise in process automation and industrial robotics. 
•	History of effectively communicating with clients and successfully completing projects as a site in-charge.
•	Extensive experience in PLC Programming, PID control, motion control, sensor interfacing and HMI Designing.
•	Experience of installation, commissioning and online troubleshooting of machines in filling and packaging industry.

•	Expertise in prototyping complex machines and modeling classical and modern control systems.  
•	Experienced with expertise in Guidance, Navigation and Control (GN&C) of unmanned vehicle.
•	Strong knowledge of probabilistic state estimations using Bayesian Filter family (KF, EKF, UKF and PF).
•	Expertise in linear and nonlinear control techniques like LQR, LQE, LQG, PID and MPC.
•	Highly experienced with robotic perception solutions using computer vision and LIDARs in UGV.
•	Strong knowledge on motion planning techniques like Manhattan, A*, RRT and Artificial Potential Field. 
•	Implemented localization, sensor fusion, path planning, collision avoidance and computer vision algorithm in UGV.
•	Implemented machine learning using k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN).

•	Proficiency in modeling and simulation using C, C++, Python, MATLAB and Simulink.
•	Experienced in implementing control systems on embedded microcontroller platform
•	Understanding of kinematics and dynamics of robotic system. 
•	History of effectively implemented control strategies for systems. 
•	Experienced in Translating physical system into algorithms.
•	Experienced in dealing with vehicle dynamics and its constraint.
•	Expertise in Linear and Nonlinear control system.
•	Strong knowledge of mathematics and physics.
•	Strong knowledge of geometry and linear algebra

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Indoor localization and waypoint navigation using laser-based Trilateration and Kalman Filter.
•	Developed a cost effective system of type B laser transmitters and receivers for indoor localization.
•	Developed a method to calculate the position and the orientation of the rover in a room using simple geometry concepts. Developed and implemented an algorithm for this method. 
•	Implemented Kalman Filter to reduce the error in position calculation.
•	Firstly, simulated and tested algorithm in MATLAB, then converted it in the C++ for ARM M4F micro controller.

company.name: University of Texas at Arlington Research Institute

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assisted students understand concepts, help with their project work, resolved their queries, conceptual and programming, and graded weekly MATLAB, Simulink and Python based assignments and exams for Graduate level course EE5322 Intelligent Control Systems with 65 students.

company.name: The University of Texas at Arlington

positions.title: Controls Engineer
positions.description:
•  Installation, Commissioning, Maintenance and Root Cause Analysis & Servicing of Palletizer, Conveyors, Bottle Filler, Bottle washer and Bottle Inspection system for beverage industry.
•  Independently commissioned fastest (Line speed 720 BPM, approximate Machine Speed 800 BPM) and most complex Palletizer and Conveyors developed by KHS-India at Hindustan Coca Cola Beverages Pvt. Ltd., Siliguri, India.
•  Received an award from Diamond Beverages Pvt. Ltd., Kolkata, India for excellent commissioning of Palletizer and Conveyors.
•  Developed/modified Some Siemens HMI (WinCC and TIA Portal) and Siemens PLC S7-300 (Step 7 and TIA Portal) program for high speed Palletizer and Conveyors.
•  As a part of Young Engineers Club at company, independently created the front end of an application in VBA - excel for automatic generation of wooden box designs for packing and logistics.

positions.title: Electrical Design Intern
positions.description:
Project: Designed Seal oil control system for Thermal Power Plant
•	Developed logic for controlling pump operation and their redundancy in LabVIEW and Arduino and designed HMI using LabVIEW’s VI for monitoring of pump status and displaying faults.
•	Interface between Arduino and LabVIEW using a package of NI named LIFA (LabVIEW Interface for Arduino-toolkit).
•	Reduced the cost of seal oil control system using Arduino and LabVIEW instead of PLC and HMI.

company.name: L&T MHI Turbine Generators Pvt. Ltd.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
Project: Design Level Process Loop with self-tuning PID controller
•   Programmed Siemens PLC for controlling speed of a Pump and command of pneumatic valves.   
•   Generated operational command for control valve using self-tuning PID controller.
